test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) announced

(B) the winner

(C) was

(D) yesterday evening
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **BCAD**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The logical order of sentence parts is determined by the subject, verb, and other sentence elements.
 
• Part **(B)** “the winner” serves as the subject of the sentence.
 
• Part **(C)** “was” acts as the helping verb connecting the subject to the action.
 
• Part **(A)** “announced” is the main verb describing the action.
 
• Part **(D)** “yesterday evening” tells when the action took place and thus comes at the end.
 
• Hence, the correct sequence is **BCAD**, forming the sentence: *“The winner was announced yesterday evening.”*

Therefore, the correct answer is **BCAD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (CBAD):** Starts with a verb “was,” which makes the sentence incomplete at the beginning.
 
• **Option 3 (ACBD):** Begins with “announced,” which cannot start a meaningful sentence without a subject.
 
• **Option 4 (BACD):** The structure “the winner announced was yesterday evening” is grammatically incorrect and illogical.
